findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 7 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 22 questions numbered 1-22; by section: 7.1 1, 7.2 1, 7.2.1 1, 7.2.2 2, 7.2.3 2, 7.3.2 1, 7.3.3 2, 7.4.1 2, 7.4.3 1, 7.4.4 1, 7.5.1 2, 7.5.2 2, 7.6 4.

22 four-mark parts (14 theory, 8 numerical) covering collision theory, rate and its graphical measurement, chemical and physical methods, concentration, temperature (Boltzmann curve), catalysis, rate law and rate constant, third and fractional orders, units of k, initial-rate data, half-life and reaction mechanism. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: instantaneous rate from a tangent, products at half the HI rate, CH₃COOC₂H₅, rate = k[H₂O₂][I⁻], first-order k in s⁻¹, Table 7.3 third rate 0.075; the SO₂/NO example is used without the 'contact process' label.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
